name: Multiplayer globe into end card
looks: A dark wireframe globe spins slowly, glowing dot nodes scattered across it with thin connecting lines drawing between a few of them, beside a two-line claim about playing anyone, anywhere. It cuts to the app icon, wordmark, a row of small feature pills and the URL, then a final accent-coloured call-to-action button.
build: The globe is a low-poly or wireframe sphere (three.js or an SVG projection) with seeded node positions; connecting lines draw on with strokeDashoffset between node pairs on a stagger. The end card locks up icon, wordmark and pills with a short stagger, and the CTA button scales in last with a soft glow.
sound: A low shimmer under the globe, a soft chime on the connecting lines, and a confirm hit on the CTA button.
prompt: Make the product's reach visible: a spinning wireframe globe with glowing nodes and connecting lines stands in for a global network, paired with a short claim. Close on the logo, name, a few feature pills, the URL and one bright call-to-action button.
